title: On the existence of minimizer on a log Fano cone singularity
summary: We prove that if $x\in (X,Δ,\mathbb{T})$ is a log Fano cone singularity over an uncountable algebraically closed field, and $ν_0$ is a $\mathbb{T}$-invariant valuation with center $x$ and $A_{X,Δ}(ν_0)<\infty$, then the value $$ δ(X,Δ;ν_0):=\inf_{ν\in \mathrm{Val}^{\mathbb{T},*}_{X,\ni x}}\frac{A_{X,Δ}(ν)}{S(ν_0;ν)}$$ admits a minimum. The proof uses the generic limit argument. Note that there is a counterexample if we discard the log Fano cone structure.
